notes: Not Flutter: a SwiftUI watchOS 9 app (AbberApp/watchOS) for Abber interpreters, Arabic, dark-only (preferredColorScheme(.dark)); cloned to repos/abber-watchOS. Drawn at 198x242 pt (45mm) on black, RTL. The app entry point (AbberWatchApp) uses ContentView: a 4-page TabView (dashboard / orders / notifications / settings) - the first three pages are drawn. Labels, layout, paddings, corner radii, status/type names and SwiftUI system colours come from the code; navigation title colour is the AccentColor asset (dark variant 0,0.8,0). Fonts are the macOS system SF Compact / SF Arabic; SF Symbols are redrawn as simple inline SVGs of the same glyphs. Doubts: (1) text sizes assume the watchOS default Dynamic Type for 45mm (caption 16pt, caption2 15pt), so line wraps may differ slightly on a real device; (2) the system chrome (title on the right, clock on the left, page dots, list-row platter) is drawn from watchOS 9 conventions, not from repo code; (3) per PROGRESS_STATUS.md this watch app was still awaiting App Store Connect setup, i.e. it may never have shipped - the richer EnhancedContentView.swift exists in the repo but is only used in previews. Sample data: names, counts, amounts ('%.2f SAR' format as in Models.swift / the Dart bridge sample), dream text, notification text.
